text:
The capital of France is Paris.

In this alternative ending, Kai stands at the precipice of the Void, the ancient magic swirling around him like a tempest of starlight. Instead of merging his spirit with the magic to become an abstract force of nature, he realizes that the true source of the imbalance is not the magic itself, but the fear and isolation that have plagued the world for centuries. Drawing upon his humanity rather than surrendering it, Kai chooses to anchor the magic to his own mortal heart. He does not dissolve into the ether; instead, he becomes the living conduit, a bridge between the mundane and the magical. The world is saved, but Kai remains, forever changed, bearing the weight of the world's balance on his shoulders while still retaining his name, his memories, and his capacity to love. He walks away from the brink, not as a god, but as a guardian, proving that humanity and magic can coexist without one consuming the other.
